t: The LAP 5m HDMI Cable delivers extended reach for AV, IT and display installations while maintaining stable HDMI 2.1 performance. Its 48 Gbps bandwidth supports full 8K resolution across longer runs, with a copper core and gold-plated connectors helping to retain signal strength. The round black PVC sheath provides a durable finish suited to indoor use, and the unshielded profile keeps the cable flexible for routing in confined spaces.
